items.name: Attack Potion
items.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Attack cards to add into your <g>Hand</g>. It's free to play this turn.

items.name: Blood Potion
items.description: Heal for 20% of your Max HP.

items.name: Colorless Potion
items.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards to add into your <g>Hand</g>. It's free to play this turn.

items.name: Flex Potion
items.description: Gain 5 <g>Strength</g>. At the end of your turn, lose 5 <g>Strength</g>.

items.name: Power Potion
items.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Power cards to add into your <g>Hand</g>. It's free to play this turn.

items.name: Skill Potion
items.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Skill cards to add into your <g>Hand</g>. It's free to play this turn.

items.name: Speed Potion
items.description: Gain 5 <g>Dexterity</g>. At the end of your turn, lose 5 <g>Dexterity</g>.

items.name: Ashwater
items.description: <g>Exhaust</g> any number of cards in your <g>Hand</g>.

items.name: Blessing of the Forge
items.description: <g>Upgrade</g> all cards in your <g>Hand</g> for the rest of combat.

items.name: Clarity Extract
items.description: Draw 1 card. At the start of your next 3 turns, draw 1 additional card.

items.name: Duplicator
items.description: This turn, your next card is played an extra time.

items.name: Gambler's Brew
items.description: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.

items.name: Powdered Demise
items.description: Enemy loses 9 HP at the end of each of its turns.

items.name: Radiant Tincture
items.description: Gain <e/>. Gain an additional <e/> at the start of your next 3 turns.

items.name: Touch of Insanity
items.description: Choose a card in your <g>Hand</g>. It is free to play this combat.

items.name: Beetle Juice
items.description: Enemy's attacks deal 30% less damage for the next 4 turns.

items.name: Bottled Potential
items.description: Shuffle ALL your cards into your <g>Draw Pile</g>. Draw 5 cards.

items.name: Distilled Chaos
items.description: Play the top 3 cards of your <g>Draw Pile</g>.

items.name: Droplet of Precognition
items.description: Choose a card in your <g>Draw Pile</g> and add it into your <g>Hand</g>.

items.name: Entropic Brew
items.description: Fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.

items.name: Essence of Darkness
items.description: <g>Channel</g> a <g>Dark</g> for each of your <g>Orb Slots</g>.

items.name: Fairy in a Bottle
items.description: When your HP would be reduced to 0, instead this potion is discarded and you heal to 30% of your Max HP.

items.name: Gigantification Potion
items.description: The next Attack you play deals triple damage.

items.name: Liquid Memories
items.description: Put a card from your <g>Discard Pile</g> into your <g>Hand</g>. It's free to play this turn.

items.name: Orobic Acid
items.description: Add a random Attack, Skill, and Power into your <g>Hand</g>. They're free to play this turn.

items.name: Snecko Oil
items.description: Draw 7 cards. Randomize the cost of cards in your <g>Hand</g> this turn.

items.name: Soldier's Stew
items.description: All cards containing <g>Strike</g> gain 1 <g>Replay</g> this combat.

items.name: Ambergris
items.description: Heal for 50% of your Max HP. If used in combat, take an extra turn.

items.name: Foul Potion
items.description:
Deal 12 damage to ALL players and enemies.
Can be thrown at the <g>Merchant</g> for 100 <g>Gold</g> instead.
